tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, positive leukocyte esterase, and >100,000 CFU/mL Klebsiella oxytoca, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. Presence of blood and mucus is noted. No casts or ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of targeted antibiotic therapy.
